summary: Iterates an array of object descriptors (count at this+0x120, array at this+0x124). For each descriptor whose 130-byte buffer is not yet allocated, validates its type and source pool slot, allocates a buffer via the vtable allocator, copies 0x82 bytes from the source pool entry, and stores the buffer into the descriptor.

operations.description: Skip the whole pass when the descriptor count at this+0x120 is not greater than 0.
Iterate the descriptor array at this+0x124 from index 0 while the index is below the count at this+0x120.
Per-entry check: only process descriptors whose buffer pointer (descriptor+0x4C) is null, i.e. not yet allocated.
Read the object type id from descriptor+0x10.
If the type id is 4 or greater, or the source pool entry at this + 4*type + 144 is null, run the init path first.
Write init markers: obj+0x14 = 51 and obj+0x18 = the type id.
Invoke obj vtable entry 0 (the pointer at this+0x0) with this.
Invoke the allocator function at this+0x4 with (this, 1, 130) to allocate a buffer.
Copy 0x82 bytes from the source pool entry at this + 4*type + 144 into the allocated buffer.
Store the allocated buffer into descriptor+0x4C, marking the entry as allocated.

unresolved: The object type id semantics (values below 4) and the source pool layout at this+144 are not defined here.
The identities of the allocator (this+0x4) and the init callback (obj vtable entry 0) are caller-supplied.
